dr-lata-goyal.name: Dr. Lata Goyal
dr-lata-goyal.degrees: MBBS, MS (Obstetrics & Gynaecology) | Senior Consultant & IVF Specialist
dr-lata-goyal.bio: Dr. Lata Goyal is a renowned Gynecologist and Infertility Specialist based in Ambikapur. With over 15 years of experience, she has pioneered assisted reproductive technologies (ART) in the Surguja district. She is known for her compassionate care and high success rates in IVF and normal deliveries.
dr-lata-goyal.long_bio: Dr. Lata Goyal has been serving the community of Chhattisgarh for over a decade. Her commitment to bringing advanced medical technology to rural areas led to the establishment of the first IVF center in Ambikapur. She is a member of several prestigious medical associations and regularly participates in national health conferences.

dr-tanay-goyal.name: Dr. Tanay Goyal
dr-tanay-goyal.bio: Dr. Tanay Goyal is a highly skilled Orthopedic Surgeon at Sankalp Hospital. He is an expert in joint replacement and sports injuries, having performed hundreds of successful knee and hip surgeries. He is dedicated to restoring mobility for his patients in the Surguja region.

dr-suneedh-gupta.name: Dr. Suneedh Gupta
dr-suneedh-gupta.degrees: BDS, MDS (Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) | Consultant Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon
dr-suneedh-gupta.bio: Dr. Suneedh Gupta is a highly skilled Oral & Maxillofacial Surgeon at Sankalp Hospital. He specializes in surgeries of the face, mouth, and jaws, including facial trauma management, oral pathology, and complex tooth extractions. He is dedicated to restoring facial function and aesthetics for his patients.

dr-sanjay-goyal.name: Dr. Sanjay Goyal
dr-sanjay-goyal.degrees: MBBS, MS (Ophthalmology) | Founder & Senior Eye Surgeon
dr-sanjay-goyal.bio: Dr. Sanjay Goyal is the founder of Sankalp Hospital and a pioneer of modern ophthalmology in the Surguja region. With over 25 years of experience, he has performed thousands of successful eye surgeries and is dedicated to providing world-class vision care to the community.

dr-nilesh-goyal.name: Dr. Nilesh Goyal
dr-nilesh-goyal.degrees: MBBS, MS (General Surgery) | Consultant General & Laparoscopic Surgeon
dr-nilesh-goyal.bio: Dr. Nilesh Goyal is an expert General and Laparoscopic Surgeon at Sankalp Hospital. He specializes in minimally invasive surgeries, helping patients recover faster with less pain. He has extensive experience in performing complex abdominal surgeries and trauma management.

dr-ankit-sharma.name: Dr. Ankit Sharma
dr-ankit-sharma.bio: Dr. Ankit Sharma is a dedicated Consultant Pediatrician, providing compassionate and comprehensive healthcare for newborns, children, and adolescents.
dr-ankit-sharma.long_bio: Dr. Sharma is passionate about child health and development, offering expert care in everything from routine immunizations to managing acute childhood illnesses. He works closely with parents to guide them through developmental milestones and pediatric nutrition. His gentle approach and clinical acumen make him a trusted healthcare partner for families in the region.

dr-ankita-bansal-goyal.name: Dr. Ankita Bansal Goyal
dr-ankita-bansal-goyal.degrees: MD (Obstetrics & Gynaecology) - PGIMER CHD, FMAS | Consultant Laparoscopic Surgeon & Gynaecologist
dr-ankita-bansal-goyal.bio: Dr. Ankita Bansal Goyal is a gold-medalist from PGIMER Chandigarh and a pioneer in 3D Laparoscopic Surgery in Ambikapur. She specializes in minimally invasive gynecological procedures, including laparoscopic hysterectomy and myomectomy, providing advanced surgical care for women.

dr-shailesh-gupta.name: Dr. Shailesh Gupta
dr-shailesh-gupta.degrees: MBBS, MD (Medicine) | Senior Physician & Heart Specialist
dr-shailesh-gupta.bio: Dr. Shailesh Gupta is a highly experienced Physician and Cardiologist at Sankalp Hospital. With over 15 years of clinical practice, he specializes in managing complex medical conditions, particularly heart disease, hypertension, and metabolic disorders like diabetes.

dr-usha-armo.name: Dr. Usha Armo
dr-usha-armo.bio: Dr. Usha Armo is a dedicated ENT Specialist at Sankalp Hospital with over 12 years of clinical experience. She is highly proficient in managing both medical and surgical conditions of the ear, nose, and throat. Her expertise in endoscopy and microsurgery has helped many patients find relief from chronic ENT problems.

dr-megha-goyal.name: Dr. Megha Goyal
dr-megha-goyal.bio: Dr. Megha Goyal is a dedicated Neonatologist at Sankalp Hospital, specializing in the care of newborns and premature infants. Her expertise in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) has saved many lives, providing the highest standard of care for the most vulnerable patients.

dr-akshaya-goyal.name: Dr. Akshaya Goyal
dr-akshaya-goyal.bio: Dr. Akshaya Goyal is a skilled Eye Specialist at Sankalp Hospital, dedicated to providing advanced eye care services. He specializes in modern cataract surgery and managing complex eye conditions, ensuring clear vision for his patients in Ambikapur.

dr-akshay-gupta.name: Dr. Akshay Gupta
dr-akshay-gupta.bio: Dr. Akshay Gupta is a Consultant Physician and Rheumatologist with expertise in Internal Medicine, autoimmune diseases, arthritis, and complex medical disorders. He completed his MBBS from Vardhman Mahavir Medical College & Safdarjung Hospital and MD (Medicine) from Dr. Ram Manohar Lohia Hospital, New Delhi. He is recognized as the first and only rheumatology specialist serving the Surguja region.

dr-ankit-gupta.name: Dr. Ankit Gupta
dr-ankit-gupta.bio: Dr. Ankit Gupta is a highly regarded Pediatrician in Ambikapur, known for his excellence in child healthcare. He provides comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents, specializing in growth monitoring, nutrition, and infectious diseases.

dr-sukirti-chauhan.name: Dr. Sukruti Chauhan
dr-sukirti-chauhan.bio: Dr. Sukruti Chauhan is a highly skilled Neurosurgeon at Sankalp Hospital, renowned for her expertise in treating complex brain and spinal disorders. She is dedicated to providing minimally invasive neurosurgical care and comprehensive neurological rehabilitation.
dr-sukirti-chauhan.long_bio: Dr. Sukruti Chauhan brings years of specialized experience in neurosurgery, focusing on brain tumors, spinal trauma, and degenerative spine conditions. She is passionate about utilizing advanced neuro-navigation techniques to ensure precision and quicker recovery times for her patients. Dr. Chauhan is deeply committed to compassionate patient care and works closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver holistic treatment.

dr-yuvan-prasannaa.name: Dr. Yuvan Prasannaa
dr-yuvan-prasannaa.bio: Dr. Yuvan Prasannaa is a Senior Consultant Anaesthesiologist at Sankalp Hospital with over 10 years of experience. He specializes in administering safe anesthesia for complex surgical procedures and intensive pain management.
dr-yuvan-prasannaa.long_bio: With a profound background in critical care and anesthesiology, Dr. Yuvan Prasannaa ensures optimal patient safety during pre-operative and post-operative phases. His expertise spans regional, general, and pediatric anesthesia. He is an integral part of the surgical team, closely monitoring patient vitals and managing post-surgical pain to facilitate smooth recoveries.

dr-rajesh-kr-agarwal.name: Dr. Rajesh Kr Agarwal
dr-rajesh-kr-agarwal.bio: Dr. Rajesh Kr Agarwal is a distinguished Consultant Urologist specializing in endourology and advanced laparoscopic urological surgeries. He is dedicated to providing cutting-edge treatments for kidney stones and prostate conditions.
dr-rajesh-kr-agarwal.long_bio: Dr. Agarwal has extensive experience in managing complex genitourinary diseases, male infertility, and urologic oncology. He is highly proficient in minimally invasive laser surgeries for kidney stones and prostate enlargement (BPH). At Sankalp Hospital, he is committed to delivering patient-centric, evidence-based urological care with a focus on fast recovery and improved quality of life.

dr-ambar-garg.name: Dr. Ambar Garg
dr-ambar-garg.bio: Dr. Ambar Garg is a leading Consultant Haematologist with a focus on diagnosing and treating blood disorders, including anemias, bleeding disorders, and hematological malignancies.
dr-ambar-garg.long_bio: Dr. Garg brings comprehensive expertise in clinical haematology and bone marrow disorders. He is deeply involved in managing complex cases of leukemia, lymphoma, and multiple myeloma. With a compassionate approach, Dr. Garg ensures that patients receive the most advanced and personalized therapeutic regimens available for both benign and malignant blood conditions.

dr-azad-bhagat.name: Dr. Azad Bhagat
dr-azad-bhagat.bio: Dr. Azad Bhagat is an expert Consultant Pathologist at Sankalp Hospital, committed to providing accurate and timely diagnostic services crucial for effective patient treatment plans.
dr-azad-bhagat.long_bio: Dr. Bhagat oversees the clinical laboratory, ensuring rigorous quality control and the highest standards of diagnostic accuracy. His expertise lies in histopathology, cytopathology, and clinical biochemistry. By working closely with clinicians across departments, Dr. Bhagat plays a vital role in the early detection and precise diagnosis of various diseases, directly impacting positive patient outcomes.

dr-anoj-kumar.name: Dr. Anoj Kumar
dr-anoj-kumar.bio: Dr. Anoj Kumar is a dedicated Consultant Anaesthesiologist, proficient in advanced airway management and regional anesthesia for high-risk surgical patients.
dr-anoj-kumar.long_bio: Dr. Kumar specializes in providing safe and effective anesthesia care across various surgical specialties, including orthopedics, general surgery, and obstetrics. He is particularly skilled in nerve blocks and epidural analgesia, focusing on minimizing post-operative pain and enhancing patient comfort. His vigilant approach ensures the highest safety standards in the operating theater.

dr-rajshree-verma.name: Dr. Rajshree Verma
dr-rajshree-verma.bio: Dr. Rajshree Verma is a compassionate Consultant Gynaecologist and Obstetrician, specializing in high-risk pregnancies, adolescent gynecology, and minimally invasive gynecological surgeries.
dr-rajshree-verma.long_bio: With over a decade of clinical experience, Dr. Rajshree Verma provides comprehensive healthcare for women at every stage of life. She is an advocate for preventive maternal care and is highly skilled in managing complex obstetric emergencies. Dr. Verma is known for her empathetic patient communication and her dedication to promoting women's health and wellness in the community.

dr-sonali-gupta.name: Dr. Sonali Gupta
dr-sonali-gupta.bio: Dr. Sonali Gupta is an accomplished Pathologist known for her precision in diagnostic medicine, specifically in surgical pathology and molecular diagnostics.
dr-sonali-gupta.long_bio: Dr. Gupta plays a critical role in the diagnostic team at Sankalp Hospital, bringing extensive knowledge in interpreting complex tissue biopsies and body fluid cytology. Her dedication to continuous learning and implementing modern pathological techniques ensures that referring physicians receive detailed, accurate reports necessary for tailored patient treatments.

dr-chetan-chaturvedi.name: Dr. Chetan Chaturvedi
dr-chetan-chaturvedi.bio: Dr. Chetan Chaturvedi is a leading Consultant Cardiologist specializing in interventional cardiology, echocardiography, and the comprehensive management of cardiovascular diseases.
dr-chetan-chaturvedi.long_bio: Dr. Chaturvedi is dedicated to the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of heart conditions. His clinical focus includes managing acute myocardial infarctions, heart failure, and complex arrhythmias. He is highly proficient in performing diagnostic angiograms and echocardiograms. His patient-first philosophy ensures comprehensive cardiovascular care aimed at long-term heart health.
